steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Booker, is something the matter?

steps.name: Mayor's Bodyguard
steps.text: Ms. Candela, the Captain is growing restless.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Reynell's toyed with him for so long, and he's restless only now?

steps.name: Mayor's Bodyguard
steps.text: Our man just sent word. He's planning to use violence to deal with the street art community.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Violence in my domain? Where did he find the guts?

steps.name: Mayor's Bodyguard
steps.text: Someone in the Coalition government supports him. He has the power to deploy all of the Coalition's military resources within the city.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Well, these bastards are certainly learning to extend their reach...

steps.name: Mayor's Bodyguard
steps.text: Should we do something to stop this plan of his?

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Let's not, for the time being. That art community's always been a whimsical bunch, making trouble for the city government. They'd be doing me a favor if they managed to take care of our problems there.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: But you need to keep a close eye on them. Mateo's a short-sighted and greedy man. With this much power in his hands, I doubt his intentions will stay all that pure.

steps.name: Mayor's Bodyguard
steps.text: That aside, Ms. Candela, will you be attending the Galería Krysztauowa's opening ceremony in a few days?

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: *sigh*... Another boy who loves looking for trouble... I'll pass. Have someone send a congratulatory gift.

steps.name: Mayor's Bodyguard
steps.text: Please excuse me, then.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Wait a moment. I have something else I need Ernesto to take care of for me. Remember to pass this on to him.

steps.name: Eager Investor
steps.text: Reynell, do you remember me? We met a few years ago.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Yes, you're... Hold on, don't remind me. It's on the tip of my tongue.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Mr. Norris, right? We bid on the same Minoan statue three years ago.

steps.name: Eager Investor
steps.text: Your excellent memory has left a profound impression on me. You kept talking about the statue that night. You recalled even the prior collectors who had owned the piece.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Right. That's one of my qualities... Remembering just about everything.

steps.name: Eager Investor
steps.text: It's been a while, but you've changed a lot. You're much more like your father, now that you've matured.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: It's too bad he left us all too soon, before he could see all that I'm accomplishing now.

steps.name: Eager Investor
steps.text: Don't be sad. Even if he isn't here to witness it, he's no doubt proud that his son's achievements are exceeding his own.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Heh... I sure hope so.

steps.name: Adulating Collector
steps.text: Mr. Kowalski, I've been looking for you.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Hey, Chetty, how have you been? An Iberian fresco just made it into the exhibition hall downstairs. You've been going all across the world this past year collecting these masterpieces, haven't you?

steps.name: Adulating Collector
steps.text: That was last year. This year, I'm planning on buying as many Yanese ink wash paintings as I can.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: I didn't expect your investment outlook to change so quickly.

steps.name: Eager Investor
steps.text: You're getting the wrong idea, Reynell. It's not our outlook that's changing quickly. It's Mr. Chetty whose mind is changing all the time.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Sounds like fun.

steps.name: Eager Investor
steps.text: (Quietly) He just remarried this year. From what I hear, the lady is very into ink wash paintings.

steps.name: Adulating Collector
steps.text: On that note, let me get straight to the point, Mr. Kowalski.

steps.name: Adulating Collector
steps.text: I want to get rid of those frescoes, and fast. Do you know a way to clear them out? Mary isn't keen to keep Catherine's collection.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: I should be able to facilitate that. I'll do what I can.

steps.name: Adulating Collector
steps.text: Please, don't be so humble. You're Szczepan Kowalski's son. Years ago, your father took less than two weeks to round up all my...

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Oh, sorry, Mr. Reynell. I didn't know you were standing there.

steps.name: Adulating Collector
steps.text: What's your problem, woman? Don't you see the three of us?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Gentlemen, this is my bodyguard. I will reprimand her in a moment.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Do you maybe need a change of clothes?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Of course I do. I can't stand around drenched in wine. Please excuse me, gentlemen.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Thanks for that. If one more person had approached me there, I would've suffocated to death.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: No need to thank me. Just doing my job.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: I thought you wouldn't be here today. The art community's puppet show is tomorrow. There must be lots to take care of there?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Our contract is still in effect.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: What a touching spirit of obligation... So, what about after it comes to an end? Where will you go?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: What's that on your back...?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Oh, my scars? Nothing to worry about. Just the price I paid for certain betrayals.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Once the contract is over... we'll leave Dossoles and search for our lost teammates.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: In that case, I guess it's not likely we'll meet again.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: With a stubborn employer like me, if it wasn't for the contract, you would've left long ago, right?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I'm something of a troublesome employee too. I'm pretty surprised that you've managed to put up with me all this time.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Thank you for your help. I hope everything works out for you in the future, Mr. Reynell.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: You didn't bring me a gift, did you?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Yeah, an album. I bought it from an artist at the community.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: The name here seems to ring a bell... Oh, I remember now. He wrote a 27-minute song last year just to curse at me.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I didn't know that... I just thought that you should take a listen to his songs.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: No matter. No need to fret. I already got my revenge.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: What did you do?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: I bought out the rights to a fair number of his songs from his previous company. Then, I gave them to the band he reviles most to cover.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I'll leave the album here. If you want to listen to it, knock yourself out. If not, then so be it.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Yes... He did indeed rip out the phone line when I called a few days ago.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Please give me a little more time. I will do whatever it takes to get my hands on that plot of land... Our development project will move ahead as scheduled.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Sir, I'm sure you know how loyal I am. It's not that I don't care, but this is a little tricky.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: The businessman who has development rights there isn't being very cooperative. We can go soft or go hard on him, but it won't matter.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: I've tried going straight to the community myself, but the people there are tough to crack. We've tried, and failed.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: No, it's not an excuse. It really is where things stand right now. Besides... It seems there is another faction within the Coalition government that's backing Reynell. I don't want to be rash here.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Yes, I'm incompetent for not having found anything on them. This is why, if I may be so bold, I'd like to ask if you have... any clues at all? Say... Who would want to steal this slice of pie from your hands?

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: No, I'm not questioning your position within the Coalition at all. It's just a possibility.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: You want me to proceed without a care to this... I-Is this really okay? If I offend anyone with these actions...

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Very well, if you say so. I won't betray your expectations.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Capitán, not even that gentleman knows who they are?

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: He doesn't, but he also doesn't care. He gave me the highest command in Dossoles, hinting that I must take care of this quickly.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: What about Candela?

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: He says he will take care of her.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: If we have his full support, then this will surely be solved without issue, but you... you don't seem very happy?

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Think about it. What kind of subordinate needs his superior's full support to finish something?

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: A trusted one?

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Hmph... It's a useless one, of course.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: I was hoping to put on a great performance bringing this development plan to fruition, but now he'll probably just think of me as an idiot who needs him to clean my messes.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Once we get that plot of land and all this over with, he might just not care anymore.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: I wouldn't be so sure of that. He's got this kid working for him who's been rising through the ranks. Supposedly, he's sending him here.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: If I don't want to be replaced, I have to do more than get my hands on that land. I need some extra accomplishments.

spans.text: If I don't want to be replaced, I have to do more than get my hands on that land. I need some extra

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Do you have any ideas?

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Of course, and I've had this in mind for some time now. Reynell's been jerking me around like I'm a fool. If I don't return the favor, that would just make me a wimp.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Now if I could swallow up his art museum, too...

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: There are two days until his opening ceremony. With this little time...

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Looks like I'll have to take the cruelest, riskiest route for this.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Weird... This is too weird...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Ernesto, I saw the garage lights on. You haven't gone to bed?

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Arleta? Come in.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Still working on the community stuff? Everyone's been so busy the last couple days.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: *sigh*... If only. I'd be so much more passionate... I'm working on repaying a favor.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: The favor from finding the medicine last time? Anything I can help with?

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: What are you talking about? No, it's a personal thing.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Brother, don't try to do everything on your own. If you need me for anything, let me know before it's too late.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Relax. It's nothing big at all. You should go get some rest.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Whatever... You've always been like this, keeping just about everything to yourself and never showing even a hint of what you're thinking. Nobody can help you at all.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: You're overthinking it, Arleta.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: How's this overthinking it? You keep acting like that, of course this is what I'm gonna think. I'm going. You get some rest soon.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: (Deep breath)

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Letting you help out isn't the same as letting you get involved in this mess. Don't blame me for this one.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Weird. How did such a large shipment of explosives disappear without a trace as soon as it entered the city?

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: There's another shipment on the 28th... and another one on the 3rd of next month...

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: There were also a few shipments of brewing ingredients around the same time. Is that how they made it in? No, the routes don't match up. There were four inspection checkpoints. There's no way they could've gotten through without being discovered.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Unless... the shipments were never going to be inspected in the first place.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: So precious that no one dared to check them?

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Luxuries... Fine wine?

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: That's... not precious enough. Probably something that could easily fetch hundreds of millions of dollars?

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: (Gulps)

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: No... I have to go check out this Galería Krysztauowa.

steps.name: Voice Behind the Door
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Voice Behind the Door
steps.text: Oh, what's going on? You've been holed up here, crying the whole time?

steps.name: Voice Behind the Door
steps.text: Luck hasn't been on my side today... I came across all these weird transpositions. What's the bass clef? I'm a trumpeter! What the hell was the composer thinking?

steps.name: Voice Behind the Door
steps.text: It only occurred to me when the rehearsal began that my score has a long multirest with only a couple notes in between here and there.

steps.name: Voice Behind the Door
steps.text: Was there a grace note above the rest?

steps.name: Voice Behind the Door
steps.text: No... It's just a bunch of whole rests over a hundred measures in a row. I counted all the way up, and I realized I must've miscounted because I entered too soon.

steps.name: Voice Behind the Door
steps.text: It was a very loud note. Everyone stopped and looked at me... Does whoever wrote the music know what a trumpet is?

steps.name: Voice Behind the Door
steps.text: *sigh*... Get some rest. Tomorrow will be better...

steps.name: Voice Behind the Door
steps.text: You sure...?

steps.name: Voice Behind the Window
steps.text: Our arts festival is tomorrow... Gah... I'm so nervous.

steps.name: Voice Behind the Window
steps.text: If you can't sleep, mind helping me work on my draft?

steps.name: Voice Behind the Window
steps.text: I thought you finished your draft a long time ago.

steps.name: Voice Behind the Window
steps.text: Yeah, I did, but the app froze on me when I was wrapping up yesterday. I went out for dinner while waiting for it to unfreeze, and by the time I got back...

steps.name: Voice Behind the Window
steps.text: Ahhh—! Stop it. That's enough. Say no more!

steps.name: Voice Behind the Window
steps.text: Stop!

steps.name: Voice Behind the Window
steps.text: Wait, stop—! Stop moving around so much when you're clutching your head! My tablet's over there!

steps.name: Voice Behind the Window
steps.text: It's gone... It's all gone... How come I'm so unlucky today...?

steps.name: Fully-Armed Soldier
steps.text: Report. The crossbowmen have the high ground. No one has spotted us.

steps.name: Fully-Armed Soldier
steps.text: Standing by for orders.

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: Haah... What a busy day this has been... What time is it? Good, still got time. I'll head to the city for a drink.

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: Yow!

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: Who would leave such a big rock out in the middle of the road? So inconsiderate.

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: Urgh... What's with everything today? Nothing's going right. I gotta find a fortune teller tomorrow and do something about my rotten luck.

steps.name: Armed Soldier
steps.text: Sorry about this, señor, but you'll have to go back. No one is allowed outside.

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: Who are you? What gives you the right to stop me?

steps.name: Armed Soldier
steps.text: Turn around, señor.

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: Hey, who are you people? Who sent you?

steps.name: Armed Soldier
steps.text: That's close enough, señor.
Soon, more soldiers in uniforms, all with stern expressions and armaments, emerge from all the streets and alleys around them and surround the neighborhood.
A few black trucks drive between them, churning a flurry of dust.
The men start unloading the trucks' contents masterfully. The sky may already be getting dark, but the objects they unload are shiningly bright.
They start to unfurl rolls of barbed wire in front of everyone, enveloping the whole community.

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: What are you doing...?

steps.name: Armed Soldier
steps.text: Señor, this is just a routine fire inspection. No need to be alarmed.

steps.name: Armed Soldier
steps.text: We will... greatly appreciate your cooperation.
